instructions_to_main_agent.react_files_format: Use .js and .jsx files for all frontend components (not .tsx).
instructions_to_main_agent.theme_rules: Strictly implement V1 Neon Purple: #0D0D14 background, #8B5CF6 / #A78BFA accents, rounded-xl (12px), Inter sans-serif.
instructions_to_main_agent.data_testids: Ensure all interactive elements (buttons, inputs, tabs, modal triggers, status badges, copy buttons, fix error buttons) include explicit data-testid attributes.
instructions_to_main_agent.full_feature_set: Implement comprehensive state management for: AI Workspace prompt generation, simulated Studio WebSocket bridge, Luau code preview with error fix trigger, Toolbox 3D asset explorer, Map voxel terrain builder preview, Prompt History rollback, Credit billing meter with checkout modal, Team RBAC, API Keys generator with IP allowlisting, and Security audit trail.
instructions_to_main_agent.no_transparent_surfaces: Dropdowns, modals, popovers, and sticky headers must use opaque or heavy crystal backdrop backgrounds with distinct 1px purple borders.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.anti_ai_slop: Do not build flat monotone boxes. Use rich layered z-indices, dark purple ambient glow cards, crisp 1px borders (#8B5CF6 with 20-40% opacity), and authentic Roblox Luau engineering terminology (DataModel, Instance.new, ReplicatedStorage, TweenService, RaycastParams, CollectionService).
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.tone_of_voice: Senior Roblox Engineer AI Tone — authoritative, precise, performance-optimized (encouraging task.spawn, typed Luau, memory management, avoidance of wait() in favor of task.wait()).
